race.comment: Open race as you'd expect for the Toorak Handicap. Want to be forgiving of EVAPORATE (1) through the Rupert Clarke. He drew wide and had to burn across to sit outside the lead but then pulled up lame after fading. Much prefer him over a mile and he draws to do no work. CHANGING COLOURS (13) is absolutely flying for Lucy Yeomans, again showing a big turn of foot to win the G2 Stocks Stakes here last time. Now down to 52kg, she can sit midfield and rip home. LADY SHENANDOAH (2) was game in the Rupert Clarke, finishing fourth. She's a G1 winner at a mile and should be right there again. REGAL AWARD (6) led at a fast clip in the Rupert Clarke and battled on very well for third. He still does a bit wrong but will look the winner at some stage. VON HAUKE (5)  was one of the better closers there and looks nicely suited to a mile second up, he's a big price in early betting.
